title: Laboratory Engineering, Field Metrology & Cleanroom R&D Technician
summary: Engineering-trained technical professional with multidisciplinary experience spanning vacuum deposition, thin-film characterization, cleanroom contamination control, field instrumentation, industrial automation, metrology calibration, and QA/QC documentation. Experienced across high-vacuum cleanrooms, defense contractors, manufacturing facilities, and demanding remote field environments.
status: Available for Laboratory, Engineering & Metrology Roles

experience.role: Metrology Technician Trainee → Field Calibration Coordinator
highlights: Performed calibration, verification, maintenance, configuration, replacement, and troubleshooting of field-deployed sensors and instrumentation across federal, agricultural, and industrial lands.
Established baseline measurements, adjusted sensor parameters, and verified output against known NIST-traceable standards using loop calibrators, pressure calibrators, and portable DAQs.

Calibrated diverse sensor systems: Dielectric/electromagnetic (Geonics EM38/31/34), TDR/FDR, inclinometers, gamma-ray attenuation, CRNS, GPR, UAV multispectral/SWIR, and ambient gas monitors (O₃, SO₂, NO₂).
Managed field inventories of instruments, spare sensors, tools, and calibration references; authored standardized SOPs for new technicians across remote national park rotations.

experience.role: VAC Lab Research Technician — Vacuum Deposition
highlights: Operated and maintained high-vacuum deposition equipment including thermal evaporators, electron-beam evaporators, PECVD chambers, roughing pumps, turbomolecular pumps, and cryopumps.
Monitored deposition rates and film thicknesses using quartz-crystal microbalances (QCM), thermocouple gauges, and ionization gauges.
Conducted helium mass spectrometry leak detection (DIN EN 1779 / ISO 20485) and plasma cleaning/ashing of precision optical and sensor substrates in ISO Class 6/7 cleanrooms.
Maintained laboratory notebooks, tracked substrate chain of custody (CoC), and developed comprehensive equipment maintenance SOPs.
Led instrumentation, controls, and automation loop implementation for gray-water facilities and community infrastructure.
Configured and maintained industrial sensors: inline oil-condition, dielectric/spectroscopic, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS), and multiphase flow sensing.
Programmed and commissioned SCADA and PLC systems including AutomationDirect DirectLOGIC/Productivity Series (ProductivitySuite) and Siemens SIMATIC S7-1200/S7-1500 (TIA Portal).
Managed field equipment logistics, technical scheduling, and system commissioning in demanding remote environments.
Prepared specimens (cutting, grinding, polishing, mounting) and executed routine materials characterization and failure-analysis testing on metals, polymers, and composites.
Operated universal testing machines (UTMs), jaw crushers, material grinders, muffle furnaces, analytical balances, and precision micrometers.
Documented test data according to strict QA/QC protocols and project-specific ASTM standards.

experience.role: Owner / Operations Manager → Owner-Operator (Class A CDL)
highlights: Managed commercial transportation operations, vehicle maintenance coordination, compliance, driver coordination, and supply-chain logistics.
Maintained vehicle records, minimized fleet equipment downtime, and ensured strict DOT/FMCSA regulatory compliance.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Engineering
education.details: Engineering education emphasizing applied technical knowledge, mathematics, instrumentation, problem-solving, and engineering fundamentals.
